settings.label: routing fee (card)
settings.name: FEE_PPM
settings.note: advertised only — what a payment pays is LND's policy on the channel (see LND actual)

settings.label: LSPS2 base fee
settings.name: LSPS2_BASE_FEE_MSAT
settings.note: per forward, advertised in get_info and route hints

settings.label: LSPS2 fee
settings.name: LSPS2_FEE_PPM
settings.note: per forward, advertised

settings.label: open fee
settings.name: LSPS2_VAR_FEE_PPM
settings.note: of the opening payment; the JIT, bolt11 and LNURL rails share it

settings.label: open fee floor
settings.name: LSPS2_OPEN_FEE_MIN_MSAT
settings.note: the least an open costs the wallet

settings.label: size rule
settings.value: payment + granted · granted = 25,000 + 50% of the payment above 25,000, at most 62,500
settings.note: computeChannelSizeSats — granted is the inbound room the JIT gives the wallet

settings.label: base
settings.name: JIT_GRANT_BASE_SATS
settings.note: every JIT gets at least this

settings.label: bonus
settings.name: JIT_GRANT_BONUS_PCT
settings.note: of the payment above the bonus start, rounded down

settings.label: bonus start
settings.name: JIT_GRANT_BONUS_FROM_SATS
settings.note: the payment size where the bonus begins

settings.label: ceiling
settings.name: JIT_GRANT_CEILING_SATS
settings.note: granted never exceeds this

settings.label: channel max
settings.name: MAX_CHANNEL_SATS
settings.note: JIT opens are not capped by this (intentional, S44)

settings.label: open-amount JIT
settings.name: LSPS2_VAR_ENABLED
settings.note: variable-amount receives

settings.label: quiesce
settings.name: LSPS2_VAR_QUIESCE_MS
settings.note: silence that finalises an open-amount set

settings.label: on-chain reserve floor
settings.name: JIT_MIN_ONCHAIN_RESERVE_SATS
settings.note: no JIT open below this confirmed balance

settings.label: scarcity ramp start
settings.name: JIT_SCARCITY_RAMP_START_SATS
settings.note: headroom where the open-fee multiplier starts rising

settings.label: scarcity max
settings.name: JIT_SCARCITY_MAX_PCT
settings.note: multiplier at zero headroom

settings.label: open fee ladder
settings.name: JIT_FEE_LADDER_SATS
settings.note: a wallet's 1st, 2nd … JIT open in the window; the last step for every open after; × the scarcity multiplier; never below the open-fee floor or the % of the payment

settings.label: promise validity
settings.name: LSPS2_PROMISE_VALIDITY_SECS
settings.note: the quote clock — an ask with no invoice secret yet is dropped after this

settings.label: promise reservation
settings.name: LSPS2_RESERVATION_HOURS
settings.note: the reservation clock — a promise with its invoice secret registered lives this long (0.119.2); payments after it fail

settings.label: live promises per wallet
settings.name: LSPS2_MAX_LIVE_PROMISES_PER_WALLET
settings.note: over it, the wallet's oldest idle promise is dropped for the new ask (0.119.2)

settings.label: live promises in total
settings.name: LSPS2_MAX_LIVE_PROMISES
settings.note: over it, the ask is refused (0.119.2)

settings.label: hold the funding
settings.name: LSPS2_FUNDING_HOLD
settings.note: the key holds the six RPCs · a wallet gets it only with init feature bit 261 (engine v363+); refused payments publish nothing (0.124.0)

settings.label: coin lease
settings.name: LSPS2_FUNDING_HOLD_LOCK_SECONDS
settings.note: the funding's inputs are leased under the adapter's own lock id for this long; released on abandon, spent on publish

settings.label: funding fee target
settings.name: LSPS2_FUNDING_FEE_TARGET_CONF
settings.note: the JIT funding's fee (BOTH opens) is LND's estimate for this many blocks, polled at each open; 144 = about a day — a zero-conf channel is in use at once (0.124.1; was a hard-coded 1 sat/vB)

settings.label: funding fee floor
settings.name: LSPS2_FUNDING_FEE_MIN_SAT_PER_VB
settings.note: the polled rate never goes below this (and the floor is used when LND has no estimate)

settings.label: funding fee cap
settings.name: LSPS2_FUNDING_FEE_MAX_SAT_PER_VB
settings.note: the polled rate never goes above this when set; 0 = no cap

settings.label: hold for offline wallets
settings.name: LSPS2_OFFLINE_HOLD_ENABLED
settings.note: on by default (0.80.0) — the wallet's Privacy dial picks its window, Off included; false here fails every offline send at once

settings.label: ceiling
settings.name: LSPS2_OFFLINE_HOLD_CAP_MS
settings.note: 3 min — the most a wallet's dial can ask for

settings.label: CLTV headroom
settings.name: LSPS2_OFFLINE_MIN_HEADROOM_BLOCKS
settings.note: the least room an HTLC must have left to be held at all

settings.label: delivery fee base
settings.name: PUSH_DELIVERY_FEE_BASE_MSAT
settings.note: the sender pays it on top of the amount; kept whether or not a route costs it (0.82.0)

settings.label: delivery fee
settings.name: PUSH_DELIVERY_FEE_PPM
settings.note: of the amount — the ceiling a cross-provider delivery may spend

settings.label: timelock margin
settings.name: PUSH_CLTV_MARGIN_BLOCKS
settings.note: added to the window's blocks on the lock invoice — 144 by default since 0.113.0 (about a day for the sender to come online after a last-minute take)

settings.label: hold fee
settings.name: PUSH_HOLD_FEE_PPM_PER_DAY
settings.note: per million of the amount per day of the window, inside the lock's fee (0.113.0; 0 = none)

settings.label: tape store cap
settings.name: TAPES_MAX_BYTES
settings.note: 256 MiB — at the cap the oldest tapes past the keep window are unlinked first; a store of young tapes refuses a drop (0.115.0)

settings.label: tape keep window
settings.name: TAPES_KEEP_DAYS
settings.note: a tape younger than this is never deleted

settings.label: address claims per name
settings.name: LNURLP_MAX_LIVE_PER_NAME
settings.note: a Lightning-address name's pool of live claims; the wallet tops up at 20 (0.115.0)

settings.label: cap per wallet
settings.name: ROUTE_REPORT_MAX_PAIRS_PER_HOUR
settings.note: a wallet's signed routing report may write this many refused pairs an hour into LND's routing memory (0.113.0)

settings.label: offered
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_ENABLED
settings.note: false stops NEW payments only — the open ones run to their end (take-backs, collections, status)

settings.label: provider's fee
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_FEE_SATS
settings.note: flat, not refundable once the lock is sent (DP: 1,000)

settings.label: share of the amount
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_FEE_PPM
settings.note: optional, on top of the flat fee — 0 (DP)

settings.label: amount ceiling
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_MAX_SATS
settings.note: per payment

settings.label: take-back window
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_REFUND_BLOCKS
settings.note: T = the block at the lock + this; the wallet stops releasing 12 blocks before T

settings.label: daily ceiling
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_DAILY_SATS
settings.note: locked in any rolling 24 hours, all wallets; the float's balance is the hard stop

settings.label: open at once
settings.name: ONCHAIN_PAY_MAX_OPEN
settings.note: box-wide; no per-wallet cap (DP)

settings.label: switch
settings.name: NWC_ENABLED
settings.note: off by default; on = this provider keeps and relays NWC requests for its wallets (never pays, never reads one) — 0.86.0

settings.label: request ttl ceiling
settings.name: NWC_REQUEST_TTL_CEILING_S
settings.note: the longest a waiting request is kept; the wallet's own dial governs within it

settings.label: relay
settings.note: derived from PUBLIC_HTTPS_URL — the same tunnel, path /nwc

settings.label: offered
settings.name: ZAPS_ENABLED
settings.note: off by default — ZAPS_ENABLED is not true

settings.label: wallets with zaps on
settings.note: each wallet's own signed choice (client-prefs.json); a wallet that never chose has them off

settings.label: receipt keys
settings.note: each address's nostrPubkey is made from DATA_DIR/zap-receipt.key and the address name — no one key signs for two addresses (0.132.0)

settings.label: wakes
settings.value: at once, then 144 / 36 / 6 blocks before the block
settings.note: a wallet's sent payment settled or failed here while that wallet is offline: its wallet user is woken (kinds sent_completed / sent_returned); nothing is sent when the sorting is in doubt, or past the block — 0.133.0, sent-watch.js

settings.label: the block
settings.note: completed: LND closes the channel on-chain at that block to collect; returned: a wallet engine before v376 closes its own channel when it returns past it (v376 and newer wait 4,032 blocks)

settings.label: Console warning
settings.note: the Console lists every HTLC within this many blocks of the block at which a channel goes on-chain over it; read every 2 min; report only

settings.label: relays
settings.name: ZAP_RELAYS
settings.note: where every receipt is sent

settings.label: sender's relays
settings.name: ZAP_REQUEST_RELAYS
settings.note: on = receipts also go to the relays the sender names (any server the sender picks; off by default)

settings.label: since start
settings.value: 0 taken, 0 refused, 0 receipt(s) sent, 0 failed, 0 not sent (the wallet had zaps off, or a chit paid)

settings.label: switch
settings.name: TATARA_ENABLED
settings.note: off by default; on = this provider offers Mix pools and declares its limits in the registry record (0.97.0: slice 1 — declared only)

settings.label: sizes
settings.name: TATARA_SIZES
settings.note: on-chain → on-chain pools

settings.label: channel pools
settings.name: TATARA_CHANNEL_POOLS / TATARA_CHANNEL_SIZES
settings.note: sizes are checked against LND's limits read from TATARA_LND_CONF (0.103.2)

settings.label: people
settings.name: TATARA_MIN_PEOPLE / TATARA_MAX_PEOPLE
settings.note: LiJ pools are 3 to 6

settings.label: relay
settings.note: derived from PUBLIC_HTTPS_URL — the same tunnel, path /tatara/relay

settings.label: public rooms
settings.name: TATARA_PUBLIC_ROOMS / TATARA_PUBLIC_RELAY / TATARA_ROOM_WINDOW_S
settings.note: 0.106.0 (Phase 2b): a size with seats waiting but fewer than the minimum gets a room on the public Joinstr relay, N = the minimum; the LIJOX pool wins if the list fills by itself before a stranger is in. Rooms now:

settings.label: dry run
settings.name: LEASE_DRY_RUN
settings.note: true = logs would_close, never closes

settings.label: silence before close
settings.name: LEASE_DAYS
settings.note: per-channel ttl overrides it (lease state)

settings.label: cycle
settings.name: LEASE_CYCLE_MINUTES
settings.note: a close lands within one cycle of the ttl

settings.label: session gap
settings.name: LEASE_SESSION_GAP_MIN
settings.note: contact after this much silence = a new session (one write, one log line)

settings.label: exclusions
settings.note: list NEVER saved — the lease closes nothing

settings.label: lncli command
settings.name: LEASE_LNCLI
settings.note: the box's admin lncli, used only by the lease close

settings.label: re-register every
settings.name: LIJOX_REGISTER_EVERY_HOURS
settings.note: the registry marks a record stale after 24 h without one

settings.label: advertised host
settings.name: NODE_HOST
settings.note: Tor or clearnet URI for peers

settings.label: filter server
settings.name: LIJOX_FILTER_URL
settings.note: none configured

settings.label: port
settings.name: CONSOLE_PORT
settings.note: loopback + Tailscale only

settings.label: route token (published)
settings.name: ADAPTER_SECRET
settings.note: a capability token every wallet receives via the registry — not an admin secret

settings.label: LND macaroon
settings.name: LIJ_ADAPTER_MACAROON_HEX
settings.note: least-privilege bake (MACAROON.md)

settings.label: data dir
settings.name: LIJ_DATA_DIR
settings.note: registries, tapes, lease state, notes, PL

settings.label: LND REST certificate
settings.name: LND_REST_CA_PATH
settings.note: checked against this file when set (0.95.0)
